bio: Hi! I'm Rebeca, a full-time beauty esthetician dedicated to enhancing your natural beauty. I offer a range of services, including lash extensions, lash lifts, facials, and waxing. With a focus on personalized care and attention to detail, I look forward to meeting you and surpassing all your expectations. Let's work together to achieve your beauty goals!
instagram_note: 429 retried successfully via Playwright with QUIC/ECH disabled (per FORGE-BRIEF 2026-08-02 fix) launching full chrome binary. Retrieved 18 profile images incl. 12 recent post covers; most carried caption text overlays or were mid-procedure/blurry and were excluded from the gallery per curation rules. Could not retrieve IG bio text (no business_email/external_url visible via this method) or scroll further without risking rate-limit; two clean, caption-free results salvaged (1 used in gallery, 1 profile avatar not used since a better Fresha staff avatar was available).
has_own_site_check: Tested beautydesignbybecky.com, .net, beautydesignbybeckymiami.com, beautydesignbecky.com, beckybeautydesign.com via curl: all fail DNS resolution (could not resolve host). Web search for the business name plus 'facebook' or 'contact' returns only Fresha listing pages, category pages, and unrelated same-named businesses in other cities. No own domain found.
language_note: Fresha auto-detected language: en. Business's own bio (Rebeca's description) is written in English. Of 20 reviews retrieved with dates/authors, ~16 are in English and ~4 in Spanish; English is the clear majority and the business's self-authored copy is English, so language=en (not the originally guessed es).
services_note: 18 services total on Fresha (some duplicated across 'Featured' and 'Brows & Lashes' groups, deduped to 15 unique above). Prices re-verified independently against Fresha's __NEXT_DATA__ payload; they differ slightly from the discovery brief's numbers in a few cases (e.g. Lash Lift & Tint is $115 not $120, Full Facial with Extractions is $130 not $150, Regular Facial is $80 not $95): used the freshly scraped values as source of truth.
